description.value: You create up to ten lights per two levels that resemble lanterns or torches (and cast that amount of light) or up to ten glowing spheres of light per two levels (which look like will-o’-wisps). The dancing light storm swirls around the caster within a 100-foot-radius area filling the area with the lights.
